uk_visa_applied.text: Apply up to 6 months before the course starts; decision usually within 3 weeks outside the UK. Fee GBP 558 plus the healthcare surcharge.
uk_visa_applied.evidence: Earliest **6 months before the course starts**. Decision usually within **3 weeks** outside the UK; paid faster options may exist | **GBP 558** + healthcare surcharge | [gov] https://www.gov.uk/student-visa (page updated 2026-11-03)

uk_visa_applied.text: Healthcare surcharge: GBP 776 per year for students, paid inside the visa application.
uk_visa_applied.evidence: **GBP 776 per year** for students (3 years = GBP 2,328; 4 years = GBP 3,104 by my multiplication; the real figure follows the visa length UKVI grants, which I did not verify) | [gov] https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay (no page date shown)

uk_visa_applied.text: Taiwan is not on the UK TB-test list, but you still need the test if you lived 6+ months in a listed country (e.g. Malaysia) in the last 6 months.
uk_visa_applied.evidence: Only if you lived 6+ months in a listed country within the last 6 months and come for 6+ months. **Taiwan is not on the list** (Hong Kong, Malaysia, South Korea, China, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, India are; the USA and Japan are not). Certificate valid 6 months from the x-ray. A Taiwanese student who lived 6+ months in a listed country (e.g. at a boarding school in Malaysia) would still need it | Clinic fee not researched | [gov] https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk

uk_visa_granted.text: A successful applicant gets an eVisa (an online record, no card): set up a UKVI account and link the passport you will travel on.
uk_visa_granted.evidence: Set up a UKVI account and **link the passport you will travel on** | n/a | [gov] https://www.gov.uk/student-visa
